subject: Show the annual land-cover map as the Marktäcke tab's first sub-tab
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-06 that the interactive land-cover map (lclu.html) is the sub-tab shown first in the showcase Marktäcke tab, rewritten to fit the main page rather than embedded as an iframe. Move the lclu.html content into index.html as sub-tab #tab-lclu (default), scope lclu.css to it, load lclu.js as a module, resize the map when the tab is shown, and make lclu.html a redirect so the public link keeps working. Move the tests that read lclu.html to the index section. Stacked on task 0148 (PR #142). Not in scope: the service, the map's behaviour and texts, other tabs. Review: Codex or owner.
